description: This file implements WiFi device management and interface control for a device, including instance management, API calls, and JSON-RPC communication, with conditional compilation for different environments.

classes.name: WiFiDevice
classes.description: Represents a WiFi device instance with methods for initialization, context management, and cleanup.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi
classes.description: Represents the WiFi interface control, providing getter and setter methods for device parameters and managing multiple instances.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of WiFiDevice for a given device ID.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a WiFiDevice instance.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the WiFi device (stub implementation).

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of hostIf_WiFi for a given device ID.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a hostIf_WiFi instance.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_RadioNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of WiFi radio entries via IARM bus call.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_SSIDNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of WiFi SSID entries via IARM bus call.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_AccessPointNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns a fixed number of access point entries.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_EndPointNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns a fixed number of endpoint entries.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_EnableWiFi
methods.description: Gets the WiFi enable status via IARM or JSON-RPC.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::set_Device_WiFi_EnableWiFi
methods.description: Sets the WiFi enable status via IARM or JSON-RPC.
